title: Opinion: India In The Age Of AI: Producer, Consumer, Or Bystander?
summary: The US and China were burning hundreds of billions on foundational model development. India's competitive advantage, the argument ran, lay in its deep software services capability, its cost efficiency and its ability to build applications serving specific markets and verticals.
